mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (current value lower than prior month) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of the months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal a severe economic slowdown that depresses corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in 60% or more of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines by at least 0.1 percentage points, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in 60% or more of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP level (relative to the prior quarter) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the instances where GDPC1 is higher than the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 2200 thousand units signal a booming housing market that increases consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of the months where HOUST exceeds 2200.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) combined with low industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) indicates supply constraints in an overheating economy, causing inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 350,000 and INDPRO < 105.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0), a further decline in industrial output signals an economic contraction that reduces corporate investment and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where INDPRO < 105.0 and INDPRO declines by at least 1.0 index point, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in 60% or more of such cases.
